CHK-MASK.note: no pass depends on a mask

CHK-CIRCULAR.note: Datum audited independently on the raw full-res scan (0.0025 deg / 0.063 mm vs alignment.json). QA ICP (T_refine) is evaluation-only, never written back. No expected value taken from this scan or from params.json. The builder's self-check (build/selfcheck, working copy, no ICP) is a consistency check, not independent evidence, and was not used.

CHK-LIKE4LIKE.note: Iteration 1: no _itN_SUPERSEDED/qa to compare. The builder self-check number in MODELING_PLAN.md (scan->CAD p95 0.281) used a different protocol (300k-face working copy, no ICP) and is not comparable to QA's 0.365 on the full-res original.

CHK-INDEP.note: Fresh context; see independence (build_log.txt read-by-accident disclosed; not used).

CHK-FILLET.note: export_check/fillets.json: 11/11 fillets OK, target == used, none REDUCED/FAILED. But the planned arch-foot round was dropped before the first run (MODELING_PLAN §8), and overlay x=40 shows the scan's arch legs curving inward to a rounded foot (y~+-7.5, z~-38.3) where the CAD leg is straight to a sharp foot at z~-39.4: the dropped round is contradicted by the scan.

CHK-PATCHWORK.note: QA census: 171 faces, analytic area 95.5 %, 11 B-spline (fillet) faces, 96 planes, 0 ruled-like; no loft(/ruled in model.py; the 3 make_polygon calls (model.py:244, 335, 391) are single closed profiles (rib section, handle revolve profile, pad wedge), not a stack of scan slices.

CHK-ENUM.note: All 11 INTAKE_CARD §5 feature families exist in the CAD (cup, bore/ledge, 3 lugs, 2 rim notches, pad, arch neck + handle, 2 spouts with screw heads, centre screw, insert floor/U rib/V ribs/2 outlet pockets, 3 wire arcs); cast lettering not modelled (declared cosmetic). Nothing hallucinated except the declared invented pocket bores (z to ~-54). Finding: several features exist but are misplaced/misshaped against the scan (V-rib radial position, floor trough around the pockets, lug ramp ends, arch foot) -- see cluster explanations.

CHK-ACHIEVABLE.note: No Tier-1 reading exists (scan-only run), so no Tier-1 miss to attribute.

PHOTO-PLAUSIBILITY.note: Photo 1 (top/inside): rim, 3 lugs, wire spring arcs across the bore, black insert with U rib, neck, collar ring, tapered black grip, cream end cap -- all in CAD. Photo 2 (bottom): two spout bosses with cross-recess screws, centre cross screw, lugs, arch neck, collar, grip, cap -- all in CAD. Rim notches not visible in photos (mesh-only, accepted at intake).

limitations.text: Tier-1 not run: 0 of 8 requested dims have a caliper reading (owner chose scan-only, DECISIONS MEASUREMENTS); absolute scale not caliper-verified (CHK-SCALE FLAG). All 8 are ABSENT, not passed. F01 is reported CAD-only.
limitations.rerun_trigger: any caliper reading (e.g. F01 bore ID, F02 ledge depth, F04 spout spacing) -> fill input/MEASUREMENTS.md, rehash, re-run verify

limitations.text: Unscanned/occluded regions carry invented or interpolated CAD: the outlet/spout pocket bores (CAD->scan clusters 0/1, ~10.5k samples, d up to 5.7 mm), the unscanned strip along the +Y side of the grip (x 105-159, CAD->scan cluster 3, 2223 samples, d up to 5.2 mm; the ray test calls it observable, so it inflates the observable CAD->scan number), rib flanks in shadow. These residuals will remain after a geometry fix and may need an ACCEPT-BAND decision.
limitations.rerun_trigger: a rescan that covers the pocket interiors and the grip strip (e.g. matte spray), or a depth-gauge reading of the pocket depth

limitations.text: Fine tessellation (0.005 mm/0.05 rad) of both STEPs is not watertight by one zero-area triangle each (datum frame at (16.7, 19.0, -46.2), spout-1 root / bottom-round junction); with it removed the mesh is watertight (qa/tess_watertight_probe.json). BRep is valid, 1 closed shell, 0 naked edges. step_check.py does not include this in its validity flag.
limitations.rerun_trigger: any rebuild -> re-run step_check and the probe

limitations.text: ICP did not converge at the default cap (60 its, qa/registration_run1_cap60.json: 0.1760 deg / 0.0468 mm); cap raised once to 400 and converged at 85 its (0.1761 deg / 0.0469 mm). Stop was reached on one iteration whose rotation fell under arccos precision; neighbouring steps were 1e-6..8e-6. Both runs agree to 1e-4 deg / 1e-4 mm.
limitations.rerun_trigger: any rebuild -> re-run ICP at the default cap first

limitations.text: Deliverable is ONE fused solid of an assembly (owner PART-CLASS): internal interfaces between cup, insert, grip, cap, screws and wire are not represented; screw heads and wire are simplified.
limitations.rerun_trigger: an owner decision to model the bodies separately

limitations.text: Observability split ran through qa/scripts/run_gate_lowmem.py (ray chunk 200 instead of the hard-coded 2000; memory only, per-point result identical) because the unmodified deviation_gate.py was OOM-killed on this 15 GB machine.
limitations.rerun_trigger: observability chunk exposed/fixed in the script -> re-run deviation_gate.py directly

miss_explanations.region: INSERT_FLOOR (funnel floor, trough around the outlet pockets, V ribs, central post)
miss_explanations.cause: Observed scan surface the CAD does not follow: floor trough near the wall and around both pockets 1-2 mm below the CAD floor; V ribs ~1.5 mm radially outboard of the scan ribs; central post r~4.6 in CAD vs ~5.5-6.0 in scan. Zone scan->CAD p95 0.727 / max 2.441. Clusters 0,1,2,3,5,10.
miss_explanations.options: REVISE (route measure): re-measure the floor profile per azimuth (trough/gutter), the V-rib centre lines and the central post radius on the full-res scan, then rebuild.

miss_explanations.cause: Lug under-face ramp ends: scan rises to z~-3 at each lug's trailing end (theta ~76/196/317) while the CAD keeps a linear ramp to ~-4.7; zone scan->CAD p95 0.740 / max 1.394, CAD->scan max 1.995. Clusters 8,9 and CAD->scan 5,6,7.
miss_explanations.options: REVISE: measure the under-face height at several stations per lug (the request already lists F03 lug under-face height at both ends) and model the end ramp; a caliper/feeler reading of F03 would arbitrate.

miss_explanations.cause: Dropped arch-foot round: scan legs curve inward to a rounded foot, CAD legs are straight to a sharp foot ~1 mm lower (overlay x=40); zone scan->CAD p95 0.420 / max 0.841.
miss_explanations.options: REVISE: reinstate the arch-foot round / leg curvature from sections.

miss_explanations.cause: Simplified torus wire arcs at slightly different height/radius and ends buried differently from the scan (clusters 4,6,7,11); zone WIRE scan->CAD p95 0.500 / max 1.333.
miss_explanations.options: REVISE the arc fits (centre/height per arc) or declare the simplification and seek ACCEPT-BAND for this region only.

miss_explanations.cause: CAD->scan only: invented pocket bores and an interpolated grip where the scan has holes (L2). Not fixable by geometry without data.
miss_explanations.options: rescan or accept (ACCEPT-BAND) after the fixable misses above are closed.

claim_boundary: Not a pass under baseline-skill plastic (p95<=0.30 / max<=0.80): QA does not certify this STEP for fit, tooling or manufacture. The cup outer wall (p95 0.092), rim face and handle agree with the scan well, but that is a regional observation, not a grade. No dimension is caliper-verified (absolute scale unverified); the one fused solid is not a model of the separate bodies; pocket interiors and a strip of the grip are invented/interpolated.
independence: Fresh agent/context that did not build the model; QA scripts from stl-re-verify only (plus two QA-owned helpers in qa/scripts/: a memory-only wrapper around deviation_gate.py and a tessellation probe). model.py was only grepped; measure/params.json and build/selfcheck/ numbers were not used. Disclosure: build/build_log.txt (not on the allowed input list) was read once by accident while listing build/; none of its numbers were used as expectations (spout axis positions for zones come from INTAKE_CARD §5 / MEASUREMENTS request F04).
